lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10-12 distinct vertical white lines observed across the primary torso; spacing is roughly equidistant at the midsection, narrowing in the posterior transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible bifurcation observed on the third line from the anterior, exhibiting a 'Y' shaped split approximately 40% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the posterior region, specifically the 7th and 8th segments, terminate midway down the lateral mass before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three high-contrast white spots arranged in a loose triangular cluster on the posterior haunch, localized near the base of the tail.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with an initial lateral divergence of approximately 30 degrees from the sagittal plane, followed by a medial and posterior-facing apical turn.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 2.5:1 ratio of the distance between terminal tips compared to the width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The terminal 10-15% of the horn structure displays high-reflectance (ivory) pixel values compared to the dark, textured basal segments.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; long dark fringe along the ventral midline and throat; orange-tan coloration on the distal limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
